arabic text:
WO KARBALA WO SHAAM-E-GHARIBAN WO TEERAGI
WO ZAINAB-E-HAZEEN WO HIFAZAYAT QAYAAM KI
AAYA WO EK SAWAAR KHAREEB-E-QAYAAME SHAH
BETI ALI KI GHAYZ MAY SUYE FARAZ BADI
ULTI NAQAAB CHEHRE SE APNE SAWAAR NE
PAYSHE NIGAAHE ZAINAB-E-MAZLOOM THAY ALI
HAR CHAND SAABIRA THI BAHOT BINTE FATHIMA
BESAAKHTA ZUBAAN PA YE FARYAAD AAGAYI
ZAINAB NE KAHA BAAP KE QADMO SE LIPAT KAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
JAB LUTGAYA PARDES MAY AMMA KA BHARA GHAR\nAB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text: After Mother's flourishing home was plundered in exile—\nnow you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
BABA GAR AANA HI THA KHAALIQ KI RIZA SE
US WAQT NA AAYE
JAB KHAAK PA DAM TOD RAHA THA MERA AKBAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
Baba, if you had to come by the Creator's will,
why did you not come then,
when my Akbar breathed his last upon the dust?
Now you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
KAT KAT KE GIRAY NEHR PA JAB BAAZU-E-ABBAS
AUR KOI NA THA PAAS
US WAQT SADA AAP KO DETA THA DILAAWAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
When Abbas's arms were severed beside the river
and no one remained near him,
the brave one was calling to you then.
Now you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
JAB FARSHE ZAMEEN BAMO FALAK LARZA BAJA THAY
US WAQT KAHAN THAY
JAB BAAP KE CHULLU MAY THA KHOON-E-ALI ASGHAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
When the earth, the heavens and all creation trembled,
where were you then,
when Ali Asghar's blood lay within his father's cupped hands?
Now you have come, Baba?

arabic text: JAB BHAI KA SAR KAT-TA THA MAI DEKH RAHI THI
english translation text: I watched my brother's head being severed.

arabic text: HAZRAT KO SADA DI\nSAR KHOLE HUE ROTI THI MAI QAIME KE DAR PAR\nAB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text: I called out to you,\nwhile I stood bareheaded and wept at the tent entrance.\nNow you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
JAB LOG BACHA LEGAYE LAASHAY SHOHDA KE
HAQ APNA JATA KE
BAS EK TAN-E-SHABBIR THA PAMAALI KI ZAD PAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
When people came and took the martyrs' bodies,
claiming their rights,
only Shabbir's body remained beneath the threat of trampling.
Now you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
JAB BALI SAKINA KE GOHAR CHEENE GAYE THAY
LAGTE THAY TAMACHAY
HASRAT SE MUJHE DEKHTI THI BANU-E-MUZTAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
When little Sakina's earrings were torn away
and she was struck with slaps,
the grieving Bano looked towards me helplessly.
Now you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
EK SHAAD KE MEHMAAN HAI PHIR QAID-O-SALAASIL
AB AANE SE HAASIL
BAZAAR MAY HUM SUBOH KO JAAYENGE KHULE SAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
We were guests for one day, and now face prison and chains.
What is gained by coming now?
Tomorrow morning we will enter the marketplace bareheaded.
Now you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
KYA AAPNE FIRDAUS SE YE DEKHA NA HOGA
KYA HASHR BAPA THA
JAB PUSHT SE BEMAAR KE KHAYNCHA GAYA BISTAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
Did you not see from Paradise
what a Judgement Day had arisen,
when the ailing Imam's bedding was pulled from beneath him?
Now you have come, Baba?

arabic text:
SHAHID RUKHE HYDER PA BIKHAR JAATE THAY AANSU
JAB KHOLKE GAYSU
CHILLATI THI ZAINAB MERE BABA MERI CHADAR
AB AAYE HO BABA
english translation text:
O Shahid, tears scattered across Haider's face
when Zainab loosened her hair and cried:
My father, my chadar!
Now you have come, Baba?
